(A)

27

  i.e.  4C2  
i.e. the available 2  two’s can be  distributed among x1, x2 and  x3 in 4C2= 6 ways. 
Similarly, the available 1 three can be distributed among  x1, x2, x3 in 3C2 = 3 ways.

 Total number of ways = 4C2  3C2  3C2 = 6  3  3 = 54 ways.

be the probability that this number is divisible by 36. Then the value of 36p is 
00008.00
